speaker: Doctor
text: The EMG results showing decreased response with repetitive stimulation are highly suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder. Have you noticed any specific improvement in your arm strength after resting for a few minutes or after consuming coffee? This would help differentiate between myasthenia gravis and a Lambert-Eaton syndrome.

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the classic pattern of fatigability and ocular symptoms; this strongly points toward Myasthenia Gravis. To confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of your condition, please undergo a "REQUEST TEST: Anti-AChR Antibodies" and "REQUEST TEST: Single-Fiber EMG". Additionally, would you like me to "REQUEST IMAGES" of a Chest CT to rule out thymoma?
